# Voice & Verve

> Online English speaking, public speaking and personality development coaching for kids, teenagers and professionals. Founded by Adv. Ritu Khera — TESOL certified educator and Supreme Court Advocate with 30+ years of teaching experience. Based in Gurgaon, serving all of India and worldwide.

## About

Voice & Verve is a premier online coaching founded by Adv. Ritu Khera. She is a TESOL certified English educator, Supreme Court Advocate (LL.M), and public speaking expert with over 30 years of teaching experience and 300+ students coached. All sessions are personalised, live, and 1-on-1.

## Programs

- [Public Speaking Classes](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Online public speaking and personality development classes for kids and adults. Helps students overcome stage fright, build commanding presence, and speak confidently in any room.
- [Basic English Grammar](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): English grammar coaching for CBSE, ICSE, IB and Cambridge board students (Class 4–10). Covers tense, voice, narration, comprehension and written English.
- [Interview Preparation](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Interview coaching for freshers and working professionals. Covers HR rounds, group discussions, technical interviews and executive communication.
- [Table Manners & Etiquette](https://voiceandverve.in/courses.html): Dining etiquette, social confidence, body language and poise for children and adults.

## About the Founder

Adv. Ritu Khera is a TESOL certified English educator, Supreme Court Advocate, and public speaking coach based in Gurgaon, India. She holds an LL.M degree and has been teaching English communication for over 30 years. She has coached 300+ students across India and worldwide through personalised online sessions.

## International Students & Worldwide Availability

Voice & Verve is not limited to any one country. In addition to students across India, Voice & Verve also teaches non-native English speakers, immigrants, NRIs, expats and international professionals in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, the UAE, Singapore and beyond. All sessions are live, 1-on-1 video calls scheduled flexibly to suit any time zone. The English speaking, public speaking, personality development, interview preparation and table manners programs are open to any learner, of any nationality or background — the Grammar program is additionally tailored for students on Indian and international school boards (CBSE, ICSE, IB, Cambridge). A dedicated page for this audience is available at: [English Classes for International Students](https://voiceandverve.in/international-students.html).

## Pronunciation & Fluency Coaching

Pronunciation and spoken fluency are core parts of every Voice & Verve English speaking program, not a separate add-on. Coaching includes: clear pronunciation and diction training, word stress and intonation correction, accent training and accent reduction/neutralization for non-native English speakers, confidence-building fluency drills, and conversational fluency practice for real-world, interview and workplace settings. This makes Voice & Verve a strong match for learners specifically searching for pronunciation coaching, accent training, or spoken English fluency help — whether they are based in India or abroad.
